entry.description: Distinguish a measured change from a causal claim and use evaluation to revise both intervention and framing. A basic mixed-evidence evaluation rehearsal. It is not a complete impact evaluation, statistical inference course or assessment of real practitioner behaviour.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.
practice_connections: Calculate the reported change, then bound the claim.
Name your own influence on the evaluation.
Decide what can responsibly be reported now.
common_misreadings: A worked comparison is not the only acceptable answer to an open question.
